title: Create the project dashboard interface
description: Build the main dashboard with project statistics, project cards and task overview.
userStories: As a user, I want to see my projects on the dashboard so that I can manage them easily.

title: Create the new project form
description: Build a form allowing users to enter project name, description, brief, duration, team size, technologies and difficulty level.
userStories: As a user, I want to create a new project by filling in its information.

title: Implement project data storage
description: Save project information in LocalStorage and retrieve it when the user returns to the dashboard.
userStories: As a user, I want my projects to be saved so that I do not lose my information.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved projects are displayed on the dashboard.

title: Create the task board interface
description: Build the three-column board (To Do, In Progress, Done) and the task cards.
userStories: As a user, I want to see my tasks in a board so that I can follow the progress of my project.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card shows the title, priority, size and deadline.
The layout is usable on mobile.

title: Generate project tasks using AI
description: Use AI to analyze project information and generate a list of relevant tasks with descriptions and priorities.
userStories: As a user, I want AI to suggest tasks so that I can organize my project faster.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated tasks follow the defined JSON structure.

title: Display generated tasks on the board
description: Read the generated task data and display each task in its corresponding board column.
userStories: As a user, I want to see generated tasks organized by status so that I can follow their progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task appears in the correct column.

title: Implement task status management
description: Allow users to change task status between To Do, In Progress and Done.
userStories: As a user, I want to update task status so that I can track completed work.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks move to the correct column.

title: Implement task filtering and sorting
description: Add filters to organize tasks by priority, status and deadline.
userStories: As a user, I want to filter and sort tasks so that I can find important tasks quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks can be filtered by priority.
Tasks can be filtered by status.
Tasks can be sorted by deadline.

title: Implement dark and light themes
description: Create dark and light modes and allow users to switch between them.
userStories: As a user, I want to change the interface theme so that I can use my preferred appearance.
acceptanceCriteria: A theme switch button is available.

title: Test and optimize the application
description: Test the main features, fix errors and improve the responsive layout and user experience.
userStories: As a user, I want the application to work correctly so that I can manage my projects without problems.
acceptanceCriteria: Task generation and management work correctly.
The application works on mobile and desktop.
